title: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar says an "IPO is not on the cards right now", and that OpenAI hopes the US government might backstop the financing of data center deals (Berber Jin/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Berber Jin /Wall Street Journal:OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar says an “IPO is not on the cards right now”, and that OpenAI hopes the US government might backstop the financing of data center deals—  Sarah Friar says the AI giant could reach break-even quickly and would like government backstop on data-center investments
